$comment: Maps each US address source id to the register rows its data comes from: the `source` values of the US situs databases (address-points-us-*.db under the data root) and the source ids of the US address layer. The house-venue tuple reader in packages/corpus/lib/us/recipes/house-venue-tuples.ts keeps a row only when every register row its value maps to holds an elected decision permitting transform and train. The address layer build in packages/corpus/lib/us/address-records/rights.ts admits a source only when every row permits fetch, extract and redistribute-data. `overture:OpenAddresses/<state>/<body>` values map to that body's own row and Overture's, and each `openaddresses:<member>` run to the row whose `access` names that run, because OpenAddresses does not relicense what it collects. `usgov-nad` is NAD read from the USDOT release. A value with no entry, such as the bare `openaddresses` of the Hawaii database, which names no body, is not admitted.
